title: Ben’s school bag
passage:
Ben packs his school bag on Sunday night. He puts in two pencils, a blue pen, a ruler and his maths book.

He also packs a red water bottle and an apple. His sports shoes go in a different bag, because he has PE on Monday. He leaves his phone on the kitchen table.

In the morning, he adds a cheese sandwich.
option5: Ben puts his phone in his bag.
option7: Ben adds a ham sandwich in the morning.
explanation: Ben packs two pencils, not three. His phone stays on the kitchen table. He packs an apple, and the sandwich is cheese.
